title: Ordered NAND tree
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be disjoint finite coordinate sets, and let the first and second decision trees use coordinates in $A$ and $B$, respectively, with sign labels. The ordered NAND tree runs the first tree, then uses its output to define a NAND continuation of the second tree, yielding a tree on $A\cup B$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the coordinate set
A decision tree on $A$ with sign labels
A decision tree on $B$ with sign labels
